test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question: As of May 2020, how many countries are members of the World Bank?
solution:
The correct answer is __**189.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **governments of the member countries** own the organisations that make up the World Bank Group, and they have the last say in all decisions on the organisations' **policies, finances, and membership.**
 
• The **Boards of Governors** and Executive Directors serve as the governing bodies for the **World Bank Group**. All significant decisions for the** organisations** are made by these bodies.
 
• The** World Bank Group is a distinctive global partnership**, consisting of five institutions working to find long-term solutions that lessen poverty and foster shared prosperity in developing nations. It has** 189 member countries,** staff from more than **170 countries, **and offices in more than **130 locations.**
 
• The **minuscule island nation of Nauru** has joined the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund (IMF) as its** 189th member.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **IBRD membership **is a prerequisite for participation in IDA, IFC, and MIGA. 
 
• The **Corporate Secretariat Vice Presidency** collaborates with the IMF and works with other World Bank Group employees to organise the application process for new members and to keep track of membership** information, including membership lists.**
 
• Since** March, the Bank Group has swiftly provided historic levels** of assistance to assist nations in protecting the weak and disadvantaged, bolstering health systems, preserving the private sector, and accelerating **economic recovery.**
